31700-D.s: The bill sets the 2009 budget statement of the Fonds economische structuurversterking (economic structure reinforcement fund), fixing its revenues at 2,477,869 thousand euro and allowing contributions to other departmental budgets for technology, energy, water and spatial investment projects. It also departs from the fund's governing law on the treatment of the 2007 closing balance, the ceiling on expenditure, and a 1 billion euro revenue increase.
31700-D.j: The memorandum justifies the departures from the fund's statute mainly by changed insights into cash flows of projects, which shift funds across years, and by the need to reallocate reserved amounts.
q: Departing from article 3, first paragraph, part a, sub 2 to 5 of the Fund Act, in budget year 2009 contributions may be allocated from the fund to other state budgets for investment projects of national importance.

In afwijking van artikel 3, eerste lid, onderdeel a, onder 2° tot en met 5° van de Wet Fonds economische structuurversterking, kunnen in het begrotingsjaar 2009 ten laste van het fonds bijdragen worden toegekend aan andere begrotingen van het Rijk
p: Departs from the fund's statutory limits so that fund money can be transferred to other departmental budgets for listed investment categories, a shift that is partly limited to named project areas and programmes of national importance.
Sets aside statutory rules on the 2007 closing balance and on the expenditure ceiling, allowing more spending to be budgeted than projected revenue.
Waives the statutory requirement to increase fund revenues by 1 billion euro plus interest for 2009.

31797-(R1871).s: This bill approves, for the whole Kingdom, the Optional Protocol of 18 December 2002 to the UN Convention against Torture, which establishes a system of regular visits to places of detention. The bill itself contains only the approval, its entry-into-force date and the publication and execution clause, with no delegations or shifts of power.

parties: Asks about the added value of the Subcommittee given existing national and international inspections, possible overlap, and why ad hoc visits are not provided for.
For the CDA members the main question is what exactly the added value is of the Protocol and of the (additional) oversight body, the Subcommittee on Prevention.
Voor de leden van de CDA-fractie is de belangrijkste vraag wat nu precies de toegevoegde waarde is van het Protocol en van het (extra) toezichtorgaan (het Subcomité ter Preventie).
Questions the added value of the Subcommittee and argues that the unannounced character of visits could help oversight.
These members believe that precisely the unexpected nature of the visits can contribute to good insight into whether a country or prison complies with a prohibition on torture.
Deze leden menen dat juist het onverwachte karakter van de bezoeken kan bijdragen aan een goed inzicht of een land of gevangenis zich houdt aan een folterverbod.
Criticises the Subcommittee for lacking enforcement powers and for announced visits, fearing the Protocol will be a paper tiger.
The Subcommittee on Prevention lacks the powers to actually take effective action.
Het Subcomité ter Preventie mist bevoegdheden om daadwerkelijk door te kunnen pakken.
Asks about the Subcommittee's added value, possible proliferation of inspecting bodies, relations between institutions, and the deterrent effect of publication.
The VVD members ask what added value the Subcommittee has, since the Netherlands already has several national and international bodies conducting inspections.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen welke toegevoegde waarde het Subcomité heeft, aangezien er in Nederland al verschillende nationale en internationale instanties zijn die controles uitoefenen.

v.summary: The Raad van State approves the Optional Protocol to the UN Convention against Torture but flags that the designation of a national preventive mechanism in the Netherlands Antilles is unclear, since the referenced 'Commissie van Toezicht op het Gevangeniswezen' is not a single overarching body under the Landsverordening. The government's reply states the explanatory note has been supplemented to address the Antilles mechanism and its independence.
concerns: The Raad asks the explanatory note to clarify which body is meant as the national preventive mechanism in the Netherlands Antilles, when it will be designated, and whether it meets the independence requirement of Article 18(1).
The Raad advises taking into account the situation after the constitutional changes within the Kingdom when designating the Antilles mechanism.

31965-XIV.s: This bill amends the 2009 departmental budget of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) in connection with the Spring Memorandum, with total spending and revenue adjustments set out in an attached supplementary budget table. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 June 2009 or the day after publication if later, with retroactive effect to 1 June.
q: The departmental budget of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) for the year 2009 is amended, as shown in the state attached to this law.

Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV) voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

31965-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statute of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS) to reflect the spring budget memorandum, adjusting expenditure and commitment figures by article in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum concerns the temporary baten-lasten status for two institutions and budget shifts, without delegating rule-making power to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statute of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2009 is amended, as shown in the statute attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32123-D.s: The bill formally adopts the 2010 budget statement of the Economic Structure Enhancement Fund (FES), totalling about 3.1 billion euro. It also allows, for 2010, contributions from the fund to other national budgets for investment projects in transport, technology, energy sustainability, water management and spatial investment, departing from the Fund Act's list of permitted purposes.
32123-D.j: The memorandum justifies the deviation from the Fund Act through the need to finance nationally important investment projects and programmes that strengthen the economic structure.
q: Notwithstanding Article 3(1)(a), points 1 to 5 of the Economic Structure Enhancement Fund Act, in budget year 2010 contributions may be granted from the fund to other national budgets

In afwijking van artikel 3, eerste lid, onderdeel a, onder 1° tot en met 5° van de Wet Fonds economische structuurversterking, kunnen in het begrotingsjaar 2010 ten laste van het fonds bijdragen worden toegekend aan andere begrotingen van het Rijk
d: allocating fund contributions to other budgets for listed investment programmes
p: Temporarily widens the purposes for which fund money may be transferred to other budgets beyond the Fund Act's categories, though the programme areas are listed.

32222-D.s: The bill amends the 2009 budget statement of the Fonds economische structuurversterking (FES) by revising expenditure and revenue figures in line with the autumn budget review, and sets aside the 2008 closing balance and caps 2009 spending at estimated revenue plus any carried-over surplus. It takes effect on 1 December 2009 with retroactive effect where publication falls later.
q: Notwithstanding Article 4(3) of the Fonds Economic Structure Enhancement Act, no more expenditure may be budgeted against the fund than the total estimated revenue.

In afwijking van artikel 4, lid 3 van de Wet Fonds economische structuurversterking kunnen ten laste van het fonds in de begroting niet meer uitgaven worden geraamd dan het totaal van de geraamde ontvangsten.

32360-A.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statement of the Infrastructuurfonds (Infrastructure Fund) through a final supplementary budget law, adjusting commitments and expenditures across infrastructure items and setting the figures in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum states that it contains only technical implementation, bookkeeping and audit-related changes, with the main shifts shown in a table of large revisions.
32360-A.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical implementation, bookkeeping and audit-finding adjustments, with no new powers claimed.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping changes or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

32500-E.s: The bill formally sets the 2011 budget statement of the Spaarfonds AOW (the AOW savings fund), in thousands of euros, including its revenues, expenditures and balances. It also fixes the unit of account and the entry-into-force rules of the budget law.
32500-E.j: The memorandum explains that the fund was set up to secure the long-term financing of AOW pensions and that withdrawals from 2020 will raise public debt; it does not justify any new delegation or power.
q: The Spaarfonds AOW was established in 1998 to secure the long-term financeability of AOW expenditure in the face of ageing.
Het Spaarfonds AOW is in 1998 ingesteld om de financierbaarheid van de AOW-uitgaven op langere termijn door deze vergrijzing zeker te stellen.

32710-B.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting revised expenditure and revenue figures and the commitment amounts for the general grant and the integration and decentralisation grants. It also fixes the entry into force of the law and gives effect to the budget table and the explanatory memorandum's grant specifications.
q: The budget of expenditure and revenue of the municipal fund for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the budget statement belonging to this law.
De begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat.

33000-I.s: This bill adopts the 2012 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Crown (begroting I), setting appropriations in thousands of euros for the Crown's grondwettelijke uitkering and functional expenditure. It contains no delegation or new executive powers, and only sets the budget and entry into force.
q: Article 1: The budget statement of the Crown (I) for the year 2012 attached to this law is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van de Koning (I) voor het jaar 2012 wordt vastgesteld.

33240-C.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget schedule of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) to reflect supplementary and realised figures, fixing the general grant commitment at €726,846,000 and integration and decentralisation grants at €42,202,000 and €499,147,000. It is a technical budget adjustment that makes no change to executive powers or oversight.
33240-C.j: The memorandum explains the small positive difference as arising because the uitkeringsfactor is not yet final, so payments to provinces may deviate from the budget, with the cause lying in differences between estimated and actual distribution criteria.
q: as long as the uitkeringsfactor 1 is not final, the amount of payments to the provinces may deviate from what is stated in the budget
zolang de uitkeringsfactor 1 niet definitief is de omvang van betalingen aan de provincies kan afwijken ten opzichte van wat in de begroting vermeld staat

34000-H.s: The bill sets the 2015 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the BES-fonds, the fund financing Caribbean Netherlands, at 31,938 thousand euros. The explanatory memorandum describes the financial oversight framework under the wet FinBES, including ministerial approval of island budgets and intervention powers of the Cft, and lists national spending on the islands.
q: The public body can in principle only make expenditures that are included in a budget approved by the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Het openbare lichaam kan in principe alleen uitgaven doen die zijn opgenomen in een door de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties goedgekeurde begroting.

34200-F.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) by adjusting expenditure and revenue figures for the final budget year, and sets the amended budget to take effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad. It is a supplementary budget (slotwet) that changes appropriations under article 1 without granting new executive powers.
q: The budget statement of the budget fund for the year 2014 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het begrotingsfonds voor het jaar 2014 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34350-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget statute (departementale begrotingsstaat) for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) to reflect the autumn supplementary budget (Najaarsnota). It sets the figures in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force rules.
q: This bill aims to make changes for the year 2015 to the departmental budget statute for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII)
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2015 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de departementale begrotingsstaat voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII)

34485-XVI.s: This first supplementary budget for 2016 amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the related agency budget, shifting amounts across policy and non-policy articles. It adjusts commitments, expenditure and revenue, including increased health care spending linked to asylum inflow.
q: The budget statement is set in thousands of euros.
De vaststelling van de begrotingsstaat geschiedt in duizenden euro’s.

34620-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statute for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), adjusting appropriations and receipts across policy articles via a supplementary budget tied to the autumn budget memorandum. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes entry-into-force and retroactive effect dates.
34620-XVII.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the budget adjustment accompanying the Najaarsnota and a motion requesting prioritisation of gender equality, not by any delegation of power.
q: The budget for gender is increased as a result of the implementation of the Van Laar / Van Veldhoven motion.
Het budget voor gender wordt verhoogd als gevolg van de uitvoering van de motie Van Laar / Van Veldhoven

parties: Asks for a table of Noodhulpfonds spending from 2014 to 2017 and an estimate of budget room if asylum inflow in 2017 is higher than projected.
Can the government provide a table of Noodhulpfonds spending from 2014 through 2017?
Kan de regering in een tabel de uitgaven uit het Noodhulpfonds vanaf 2014 t/m 2017 weergeven?
Has no comments or objections at this stage.
They currently wish to make no comments or objections on this.
Zij wensen hierover momenteel geen op- of aanmerkingen te plaatsen.
Argues the budget is incomprehensible and priorities are unclear, asks for an explanation, and asks whether 10 percent of the windfall counts as substantial under the adopted Van Laar motion.
The impenetrable way of budgeting therefore calls for a rethink and adjustment of the budgeting system; it is no longer followable.
De ondoorgrondelijke manier van begroten vraagt daarom om een herbezinning en aanpassing van de begrotingssystematiek; het is niet meer te volgen.

Asks for the cause of the attribution error in asylum spending to ODA, whether other errors exist, and detailed tables on the budget shortfall and cuts, partly to honour an adopted motion protecting ongoing programmes.
They would like a tabular overview showing the changes for the years 2016 through 2019.
Graag verkrijgen zij in tabelmatige vorm een overzicht waarin de wijzigingen verwerkt staan voor de jaren 2016 tot en met 2019.
Questions why the adopted Van Laar and Voordewind motions were not implemented, why the 460 million was transferred without going to poverty projects, and what the recalculation was.
Why was the motion not implemented?
Waarom is de motie niet uitgevoerd?
Finds it unacceptable that the government set aside the Van Laar motion, asks for an explanation, and asks how the structural shortfall and allocation of the transferred funds will be justified.

34845-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2017 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) and the related agency budget, reallocating funds across policy and non-policy articles. It contains no new delegations of rule-making power or changes to oversight, review or citizens' protections.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2017 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2017 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34873-(R2098).s: The bill amends the 2010 Kingdom Act that set the sea boundaries between Curaçao and Bonaire and between Sint Maarten and Saba, replacing the Sint Maarten–Saba boundary coordinates and Annex 2 to implement a 2016 maritime delimitation treaty with France in the Caribbean. It also sets the entry-into-force date by royal decree.
q: This Kingdom Act enters into force on a date to be determined by royal decree.
Deze rijkswet treedt in werking met ingang van een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: entry-into-force date set by royal decree

35925-XIV.s: This bill formally establishes the 2022 budget for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, including the departmental budget statement, the budget of the NVWA food and product authority as a baten-lastenagentschap, and the budget of the Diergezondheidsfonds (animal health fund). The explanatory memorandum describes policy priorities, budgets, subsidies and planned evaluations but contains no new delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2022 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2022 wordt vastgesteld.

35925-XVI.s: This bill sets the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS) at about €26.1 billion in expenditure and €28.5 billion in commitments, along with the budgets of three executive agencies. It is a budget act whose explanatory memorandum covers policy priorities, agency and ZBO funding, and healthcare spending projections rather than new delegated powers.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2022 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2022 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, with no remarks, that the 2022 budget bill for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport announces changes to several budgets, referring to attachments, and forwards the bill for submission in September.

36120-C.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), raising the commitment amount for the general grant and setting integration and decentralisation grants. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively from 1 June 2022.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the provinciefonds for the year 2022;
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2022;

36410-A.s: This bill formally establishes the 2024 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Mobility Fund, setting expenditure, commitments and receipts in thousands of euros for infrastructure, waterways and related items. The explanatory memorandum covers budgetary adjustments, the Coast Guard's spending and DBFM contract accounting, but the bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making powers.
q: The budget statement of the Mobility Fund, referred to in article 2 of the Mobility Fund Act, belonging to this law, is established for the year 2024.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Mobiliteitsfonds, genoemd in artikel 2 van de Wet Mobiliteitsfonds, voor het jaar 2024 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Mobiliteitsfonds budget bill for 2024 without remarks and recommended submission to the Tweede Kamer. The document is a transmittal of the advice, with no separate government reply.

36600-XVII.s: This bill adopts the 2025 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Assistance, setting appropriations in thousands of euros across policy articles. The explanatory memorandum describes budget cuts, reallocations and planned reporting changes, but the bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making power.
q: Article 1: The budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2025 is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.
